name: General AI assistants
blurb: Chatbots you talk to for almost anything: questions, writing, planning, files, images.

name: AI agents
blurb: Hand over a whole task (research, booking, building a spreadsheet) and get the finished result back.

name: Search & research
blurb: Tools built around finding, citing and working through sources.

name: Image generation & editing
blurb: Make or edit pictures from a text description or a reference photo.

name: Photo editing & upscaling
blurb: Fix, retouch, remove objects and upscale your own photos.

name: Video generation
blurb: Short clips from text or images, plus talking-avatar video.

name: Music, voice & dictation
blurb: Songs, voiceovers, voice cloning and speech-to-text.

name: Slides, documents & design
blurb: Decks, documents and social graphics generated from a prompt.

name: Writing, notes & meetings
blurb: Grammar help, meeting notes, email and note-taking with AI.

name: Learning & study
blurb: Tutors that teach instead of just giving answers, and language practice.

name: Translation
blurb: Translate text, documents and live conversations.

name: Coding assistants
blurb: AI that writes, edits and reviews code in your editor or terminal.

name: No-code app & website builders
blurb: Describe an app or site in plain English and get a working one.

name: AI browsers
blurb: Web browsers with an assistant built in, some able to click around for you.

name: Phone & home assistants
blurb: Voice assistants built into your phone or smart speaker.

name: AI glasses & gadgets
blurb: Hardware with an assistant built in.

name: Run AI on your own computer
blurb: Free apps that run open models offline, so nothing leaves your machine.

name: AI companions
blurb: Chat characters for company, role-play and practice conversations. Mind the age limits.
